description.html: The artificial plant with round leaves has long stems with round green leaves along their whole length. Its fresh, bright green look goes well with almost any decor, and the plant stands on a light-colored base.

The advantage of an artificial plant is that it looks the same day after day: it does not rot, lose leaves or need strong lighting or fertilizer. It does not affect water parameters, and fish use it as cover, especially younger and shyer ones.

Because of its height, it suits the middle and back of the aquarium. Round leaves give a softer look than narrow-leaved plants, so it is worth combining them for more varied texture. When algae appear on the leaves, take the plant out, rinse it under lukewarm water and brush it with a soft brush. Do not use chemical cleaners, as residues can end up in the water.
